environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate task in VPC subnet subnet-0a3f7c9e2b (10.4.128.0/24). Subnet route table rtb-07d2a4f has only local route (10.4.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry — no internet gateway association, no NAT gateway, no NAT instance, no VPC peering to internet-connected VPC. VPC endpoint policy on the ECR endpoint (vpce-0x8a3b) restricts to ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer and ecr:BatchGetImage only. No S3 gateway endpoint configured. DNS resolution returns NXDOMAIN for all external hostnames. Task ENI has no public IP assignment. Security group sg-0f4e2a1 egress rules: allow TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr prefix list) only; all other egress denied.

config.internet_gateway: not attached to subnet route table
config.security_group_egress: TCP 443 to prefix-list pl-63a5400a only; implicit deny all other
config.dns_resolution: VPC internal only, no Route53 resolver outbound endpoints
